notes.title: "Come on Baby!" can play online with your friends in real time!
notes.content:
Hi!
Now, You can now "come on baby!" online in real time with your online friends!
Enjoy Steam's new service "Remote Play Together"!
Thank you.

Please check the link below for usage.
(!) All users must have the latest Steam client installed.
https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

Hello, Everyone!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Localize Add & Graphic Quality UP!
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone!

1. Localization support has been added for the following +4 languages.
- Traditional Chinese 
- Japanese
- Polski
- Turkish
2. Winter-season Graphics were becoming High definition.
3. Resolved the Joypad & Stick Recognition issue.

Thank you!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Graphic Quality Up! (Summer)
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone!
The overall graphics quality improvement update for the "Summer Season" has been made.
We'll also have quality updates for "Winter Season"
Thank you!

notes.title: [Update] Localization Added!
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone!

1. Localization support has been added for the following languages.
- Simplified Chinese 
- Russian
- Spanish
- German
- Portuguese
- French
- English
- Korean
Next time, other languages will be added in the future! :)

2. Achievements +17 Added.
3. Global Ranking New Main Season(~12/31) Open.
4. Some graphics were becoming high definition.
5. Balance tuning and optimization of the game.

Other languages will be added in the future.
Thank you!

notes.title: Online Multiplay "Come on Baby!" with friends!
notes.content:
Hello! 
The beta version of Steam's new service "Remote Play Together" is now available!
Now you can play "Come On Baby!" with your online friend on the real-time online multi-game.
Please check the link below for how to use this service.
(!) Play-users must have the latest Steam client installed.

Now this service is beta, so it seems like it's not perfect yet,
but We look forward to improving network reliability and compatibility in the future.
Thank you.

[Remote Play Together Intro]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687

notes.title: Character Display
notes.content: In "Come on Baby!", We create and animate all 2D cuts by angle for a dramatic and comical look of our characters.so please understand that Dot may look rough sometimes when the focus is Zoom.
